raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1
context:
  name: "openmeeg"
  version: "2.6.0"
  build_number: 0
  sha256: 9f19fdf35e30fdad7a0e8958e8c90a58b22d23c0542bf95978a8e9408d5e41cb

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/${{ name }}/${{ name }}/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: ${{ sha256 }}

# https://conda-forge.org/docs/maintainer/knowledge_base.html
build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  python:
    version_independent: ${{ is_abi3 }}
  skip: is_abi3 and not is_python_min
  script:
    file: build
    env:
      # One stable ABI build covers all regular Pythons, but free-threaded ones
      # have no stable ABI and get their own builds
      PYTHON_USE_SABI: ${{ "ON" if is_abi3 else "OFF" }}

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - numpy
    - cmake >=3.19
    - make
    - if: not win
      then: ninja
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: osx
      then: llvm-openmp
    - if: win
      then: pthread-stubs
    - swig

  host:
    - python
    - if: is_abi3
      then: python-abi3
    - numpy
    # Link against the generic BLAS/LAPACK interfaces so that users can switch
    # the backend, e.g. conda install "libblas=*=*_mkl"
    - libblas
    - libcblas
    - liblapack
    - liblapacke
    - libmatio
    - setuptools >=68.0.0
    - setuptools_scm >=6.2
    - wheel >=0.37.0

  run:
    - python
    - if: win
      then: ucrt
    - libmatio

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - openmeeg
      python_version:
        - if: is_abi3
          then: ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - requirements:
      run:
        - if: not win
          then: pytest
          else: pytest <8
        - packaging
        - pip
        - if: is_abi3
          then: abi3audit
    script:
      - om_minverser --help
      - if: unix and is_abi3
        then:
          - ls $SP_DIR/openmeeg/_openmeeg.*
          - abi3audit $SP_DIR/openmeeg/_openmeeg.abi3.so -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}
      - if: win and is_abi3
        then:
          - dir %SP_DIR%\openmeeg\_openmeeg.*
          - abi3audit %SP_DIR%/openmeeg/_openmeeg.pyd -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}
          # In case we run into problems in the future:
          # curl -LO https://github.com/lucasg/Dependencies/releases/download/v1.11.1/Dependencies_x64_Release.zip
          # powershell.exe -nologo -noprofile -command "& { Add-Type -A 'System.IO.Compression.FileSystem'; [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::ExtractToDirectory('Dependencies_x64_Release.zip', 'Dependencies'); }"
          # .\Dependencies\Dependencies.exe -modules %SP_DIR%\openmeeg\_openmeeg.pyd
      - python -c "import faulthandler; faulthandler.enable(); import warnings; warnings.simplefilter('error'); from packaging.version import parse; import openmeeg; print(openmeeg.__version__); assert parse(openmeeg.__version__) == parse('${{ version }}'), openmeeg.__version__"
      - pip check
      - pip show openmeeg
  # Functional tests, which need the data from the source tree. On macOS use
  # Accelerate, the fastest implementation there; elsewhere the default one.
  - files:
      source:
        - data/
    requirements:
      run:
        - if: not win
          then: pytest
          else: pytest <8
        - if: osx
          then: libblas * *_newaccelerate
    script:
      env:
        OPENMEEG_DATA_PATH: data
      content:
        - pytest --pyargs openmeeg -m "not slow" -v

about:
  homepage: https://openmeeg.github.io/
  license: CECILL-B
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: >
    A C++ package for solving the forward problems of electroencephalography (EEG) and magnetoencephalography (MEG).

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - agramfort
    - larsoner
